paragraphs.text: Landshome is a port town on the north shore of the continent Otaria on the plane of Dominaria .
Landshome lies north of Krosa on the shore of Otaria , but likely south of Tamingazin .

In 4205 AR , the war veterans Balthor Rockfist and Matoc docked at Landshome upon their arrival back to Otaria after fighting in the first Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria in foreign lands. Although the town had not sustained any physical damage from the war, it was noticeably depopulated compared to the last time they had been there, a marked sign of the effects of the Phyrexian plague spores that had swarmed the entire globe, even if Otaria was spared much of the direct warfare.
